highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 previews the Skia m153 engine update and its upstream rendering corrections.
highlights_body: Linux applications that rely on a particular font fallback face should review the changed fontconfig selection behavior.

breaking.title: Linux font fallback can select a different face
breaking.body: Skia now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort path. Applications that require deterministic fallback glyphs or metrics should specify an explicit family and style or bundle the required typeface.

bullets.detail: Brings the 4.153 preview line to the Chrome m153 renderer.
Includes Chrome m153 correctness, bug-fix, and buffer-upload updates in the bundled engine.

preview_summaries.v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6: Preview 1 opened the 4.153 line with the Skia m153 engine update and its upstream fixes.
preview_summaries.v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2: Release Candidate 1 finalized the preview line for broader validation.

harfbuzz_summary: Improves the native HarfBuzz build's warning handling without changing the managed HarfBuzzSharp API.
